# musickit-api-mock

> Apple Music API mock for MusicKit JS — runs as an in-process request interceptor inside browser-automation tests.

The library intercepts Apple Music API requests in-process, so a page running
MusicKit JS hits the mock instead of `api.music.apple.com`. A mock instance
exposes three configuration surfaces — `mock.data` (resource sources),
`mock.endpoints` (HTTP response overrides), and `mock.browser` (in-page shim
state) — and is bound to a browser session by a host adapter.

## Overview

- [Home](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/index.md): What the library is, what it intercepts, and a minimal end-to-end example.

## Guide

- [Guide](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/guide/index.md): Map of the hand-written walkthroughs.
- [Getting started](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/guide/getting-started/index.md): Install, build a mock, bind it to a page, drive MusicKit JS.
- [Surfaces overview](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/guide/surfaces/index.md): The three configuration surfaces and which one a given scenario belongs to.
- [Playwright integration](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/guide/playwright/index.md): Binding the mock to a Playwright page or browser context, sync and async.

## Reference

- [Reference](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/reference/index.md): Map of the generated API reference pages.
- [MusicKitApiMock](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/reference/mock/index.md): The mock class — the library entry point.
- [mock.data](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/reference/data/index.md): Resource dataclasses and the lookup context behind `mock.data`.
- [mock.endpoints](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/reference/endpoints/index.md): Response variants and callback contexts behind `mock.endpoints`.
- [mock.browser](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/reference/browser/index.md): In-page shim state behind `mock.browser`.
- [Playwright adapter](https://hotaritobu.github.io/musickit-api-mock/dev/reference/playwright/index.md): The Playwright adapter entry points.
